question.text: A portfolio manager running a 'Momentum' investment approach must disclose the investment approach details under SEBI (PM) Regulations 2020. Which document must include the investment approach?

answer.text: Simplified Disclosure Document and the PMS Agreement
Brochure at point of sale only

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires each investment approach (IA) to be formally disclosed in the Simplified Disclosure Document (Sep 09, 2025 circular) and reflected in the PMS Agreement, with benchmark tagging. The Trap: Factsheets and annual reports are ongoing disclosures but aren't the primary regulatory anchor for the IA definition. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A tests the DD from the Distributor side; XXI-B tests PM operational side. Manager's Pro-Tip: Every new IA launched requires a benchmark tagging exercise — pick the benchmark that best reflects the approach's return drivers.
